# StratMarket by Elvaris Capital

> StratMarket (https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in) is an institutional-grade quantitative trading strategy marketplace engineered and operated by Elvaris Capital (parent organization: https://elvariscapital.in).

## Overview
StratMarket provides traders, fund managers, and systematic investors with 100% open-access quantitative algorithmic trading strategies. All strategies are researched using AI-assisted hypothesis generation, verified with multi-year tick-level backtests, and stress-tested with Walk-Forward Optimization (WFO) and Monte Carlo simulations.

## Parent Organization
- **Parent Organization:** Elvaris Capital
- **Official Website:** https://elvariscapital.in
- **Role:** Quantitative research lab, algorithmic strategy design, institutional risk governance, and VPS signal execution engine.

## Core Capabilities
- **Systematic Strategy Catalog:** 14 verified quant strategies across Pine Script (PS-01 to PS-04) and Python MT5 Single-Digit Drawdown Ensembles (PY-01 to PY-10).
- **Public Research Reports:** Unauthenticated public access to institutional research reports including hypothesis, Sharpe ratio, Calmar ratio, maximum drawdown, and slippage assumptions.
- **Private Live Interactive Charts:** High-fidelity Vela canvas candlestick streaming with real-time indicators and Long/Short execution visual trade boxes (free with login).
- **Real-Time Signal Relays:** Sub-50ms execution alerts dispatched via authenticated Webhooks, Chrome desktop push notifications, and instant email delivery.
- **Sovereign Risk Governance:** Server-enforced drawdown circuit breakers, Friday session closing rules, and volatility-adaptive stop losses.

## Quantitative Research Blog & Technical Deep Dives
- [Quantitative Blog Hub](https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/blog): Complete index of institutional research articles and engineering tutorials.
- [80% Win Rate Gold Strategy (PS-01 Breakdown)](https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/blog/pine-script-v5-gold-xauusd-strategy-80-winrate): 200 EMA macro filter, 2.1σ volatility bands, RSI boundaries, and zero lookahead bias in Pine Script v5.
- [London Session Breakout Strategy Guide](https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/blog/london-session-breakout-strategy-guide): How institutional quants trade the London open liquidity sweep on XAUUSD M15 (PS-03).
- [US Afternoon Momentum Reversal (83.3% Win Rate)](https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/blog/us-afternoon-momentum-reversal-trading): Trading post-New York volatility expansions and London close liquidity handover (PS-02).
- [Python MT5 Single-Digit Drawdown Ensembles](https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/blog/python-mt5-algorithmic-trading-ensemble-guide): Developing multi-strategy ensembles with sub-10% drawdown in Python 3.12 and MetaTrader 5.
- [Calmar Ratio vs Sharpe Ratio Guide](https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/blog/calmar-ratio-vs-sharpe-ratio-quant-trading): Why institutional quantitative funds prioritize Calmar over Sharpe for tail risk and drawdown recovery.
- [TradingView Webhook Automation (<50ms)](https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/blog/how-to-automate-tradingview-alerts-webhook-execution): Automating TradingView Pine Script alerts to VPS execution webhooks with HMAC SHA-256 signatures.
